title: Design: the New Tier page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Tier.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows with New Tier at the top right.

Step 2:

  • The page shows the next tier number beside a large empty name field with the placeholder "Tier name" and the hint "New tiers go last, as Tier" and the number under it.
  • Cancel and Create Tier (blue) sit at the top right.
  • Tabs Pricing and Customers (0) sit under the name.
  • The matrix list has columns Matrix, Work Order Matrix and Part Sale Matrix and no checkboxes, as in picture 2.11.
